verses.text: The Philistines fought against Israel. The men of Israel ran away from them, and many were killed on Mount Gilboa.
The Philistines chased Saul and his sons closely, and they killed Saul's sons Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua.
The fighting was fierce around Saul. The archers caught up with him and wounded him.

Saul said to the young man who carried his armour, "Pull out your sword and kill me with it. If you don't, these uncircumcised men will come and make fun of me and hurt me." But the young man was too afraid to do it. So Saul took his own sword and fell on it.
When the armour bearer saw that Saul was dead, he also fell on his own sword and died.
So Saul and his three sons died, and all his family died together.
When all the Israelites in the valley saw that the army had run away and that Saul and his sons were dead, they left their towns and ran away too. Then the Philistines came and lived in those towns.
The next day, when the Philistines came to strip the dead, they found Saul and his sons lying dead on Mount Gilboa.
They stripped Saul's body and took his head and his armour. Then they sent messengers all through the land of the Philistines to spread the news to their idols and to their people.
They put his armour in the temple of their gods and hung his head in the temple of Dagon.
When all the people of Jabesh Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,
all their brave men went and took the bodies of Saul and his sons and brought them to Jabesh. They buried their bones under the great tree in Jabesh, and they went without food for seven days.
Saul died because he was unfaithful to the LORD. He did not obey the LORD's word. He even asked advice from a woman who talked to the spirits of the dead,
instead of asking the LORD. So the LORD put him to death and gave the kingdom to David son of Jesse.
